title: ORE Valuation Module
description: Valuation method parameters. ORE v0.1 supports discounted cash flow and direct capitalization. Each method listed in `methods` must have its parameter object present.

analysisStartDate.description: First day of analysis month 1. Conventionally equals rentRoll.asOfDate; all growth, downtime, and discounting measure from this date.

methods.description: Valuation methods this file is prepared for.

purchasePrice.description: Assumed or actual purchase price, USD. Optional: when present, engines report IRR/NPV against it; when absent, engines report concluded value only.

acquisitionCostsPercent.description: Closing costs at acquisition as a percent of purchase price, added to the initial outflow.

holdPeriodYears.description: Hold period in whole years from analysisStartDate. Reversion occurs at the end of the final year.

discountRatePercent.description: Annual discount rate applied to unlevered cash flows, in percent.

reversionCapRatePercent.description: Cap rate applied to forward (hold + 1 year) NOI to compute gross reversion value, in percent.

sellingCostsPercent.description: Costs of sale as a percent of gross reversion value, deducted to reach net reversion.

discountTiming.description: Discounting convention. monthly: end-of-month cash flows discounted at the equivalent monthly rate ((1+r)^(1/12)-1). annual: end-of-year aggregated cash flows discounted annually. Declared explicitly so every engine produces the identical NPV.

noiBasis.description: NOI to capitalize. year1: forward 12 months from analysisStartDate per the full assumption set. inPlace: annualized contractual rent in force at analysisStartDate less annualized expenses, ignoring rollover and lease-up.
